errors.evidence: The description provides the numerical breakdown for the "All Changes" chart but completely omits the numerical values for the second chart, "All Errors". The values for the "All Errors" chart are: P (56%), R (29%), RW (6%), NW (5%), PW (3%), and N (1%).

errors.text_span: The charts do not feature a traditional legend
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect and contradicts the previous sentence in the description. A legend is clearly visible to the right of the two charts, mapping colors to the categories P, PW, R, RW, N, and NW.

errors.text_span: no slices are visually emphasized through explosion, offset, or bolding
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. In both pie charts, five of the six slices (PW, R, RW, N, and NW) are clearly exploded or offset from the main slice (P).
